Rules
-----
These sources are an unmodified upstream snapshot. Do not patch them in place:
local fixes belong in Native~/xatlas-unity-bridge.cpp, so the snapshot stays
diffable against upstream. To move to a newer upstream revision, replace both
files wholesale, update the commit and both dates above, and rebuild the
binaries through the build-native workflow.
